trigger_condition: Independent dispatch-progress admission returns null after a reported acknowledgement.
guard_snippet: if (progress is null) return new(predecessor, false, "publication-progress-unavailable");
potential_consequence: Dispatch advances and reports completion despite refused or unconfirmed durable progress.

trigger_condition: An expired certificate follows a readable revocation after an entirely expired binding prefix.
guard_snippet: if (transition.Event is not null) sawReadableTransition = true; if (transition.Expired is not null && sawReadableTransition) throw InvalidHistory();
potential_consequence: Expired suffixes pass validation because readable revocations leave bindings.Count at zero.
